_meta.description: Fixed test set for seat-research eval harness. Used to measure fabrication + support quality across prompt versions.
_meta.purpose: Run research prompt against this set → run adjudicator → aggregate → compare prompt versions over time.

selection_criteria: Include mixed difficulty: large house with quirks, small house with few hazards, mid-size typical
All currently have live productions (ensures AVFMS has recent user reports)
Mix of operators (Shubert / Jujamcyn / Nederlander / ATG) — catches operator-specific bias

theaters.notes: Already-live baseline. Large house. Mezz overhang + side-angle quirks. Adjudicator caught 4 UNSUPPORTED claims on first pass; now fixed to 5 sections.
Already-live baseline. Small intimate house. Acoustically strong. Fewer hazards. Re-verdicted Orch Front from solid→skip after adjudicator.
Largest Broadway house. Balcony is infamous — nosebleed with distance/resolution issues. Currently hosting Wicked. Rich AVFMS data expected.
Smallest Broadway theater. Mostly plays. Modern renovation (2018). Few known hazards — tests whether the methodology handles sparse-evidence cases without fabricating.
Mid-size, typical. Known for Les Mis residencies. Balanced difficulty — tests the prompt's ability to produce 'solid' verdicts for sections without inventing quirks.
